start_protocol: pre-settled nominal-pose PD: default joint positions commanded directly, bypassing policy action processing; NOT passive zero-torque settling; actual fallen/standing status recorded per trial
settle_controller: direct nominal-position PD, not policy zero action; not zero torque
settle_execution: physics/action substeps only; termination checked each control step; auto-reset prohibited; no learned policy, reward computation, curriculum or interval events
settled_definition: at least 0.25 s continuous any-body contact >1 N, root speed <0.10 m/s, angular speed <0.20 rad/s, every joint speed <0.50 rad/s before policy starts
fallen_start_definition: current any-body contact >1 N and either tilt from upright >=60 deg or base contact >1 N with height <0.26 m; eligible only if settled and not already standing
success_count_definition: Three-actor experiment: original recovery success and final strict hold are separate from final150intervals controlled by refinement actor. No walk/run claim.
time_definition: policy time starts AFTER optional settling; onset of the first stable interval held for hold_s; policy simulation includes hold_s after horizon_s; settling is excluded
criterion: gravity error < 0.35, height 0.30-0.55 m, speed < 0.50 m/s, angular speed < 1.00 rad/s, 4 simultaneous foot vertical forces > 5 N, no base contact, feet on correct body sides (0.06 < signed lateral < 0.30 m), knees on correct sides (>0.04 m), fore/hind feet on correct ends (>0.08 m), each joint offset <0.65 rad; all continuously held for hold_s

handoff_controller.gate: tilt<30deg and body angular speed<1rad/s continuously for0.2s; one-way latched

action_representation.pre_policy_handover: direct nominal-position PD, not policy zero action

transition_experiment.known_baseline_caveat: Stand3547-only upright20/20 is NOT dual-policy upright. Frozen old dual1999-to3547 cold controls were upright12/20, side9/20, upside_down20/20; hard equivalence must be measured, never assumed.
transition_experiment.heldout_reuse_caveat: Repeatedly inspected bank cases are development evidence, not a fresh generalization test.

mirror_experiment.selection_rule: eligible_settled_fallen_at_real_policy_start AND normalized_projected_gravity_body_y < -cos(30deg); mode off selects none; no requested pose/ID/outcome input
mirror_experiment.roll_equation: selected: J12(roll_actor(M48(real_obs))); unselected: roll_actor(real_obs); stand_actor always real_obs
mirror_experiment.tensor_dict_copy: clone(recurse=True), then assign a newly allocated masked policy tensor; never a shallow clone or a write into real observations
mirror_experiment.network_normalization: both actual actors must expose Identity actor_obs_normalizer and actor_obs_normalization=False

observation_field_semantics.real_policy_observation: explicit duplicate of real measured native48
observation_field_semantics.roll_policy_input_observation: actual48 passed to roll actor, virtual reflection only for fixed selected rows
observation_field_semantics.roll_actor_output_model_raw_action: roll actor output before inverse reflection, model coordinates
observation_field_semantics.roll_actor_output_physical_raw_action: native real12 after inverse reflection for selected rows
observation_field_semantics.roll_actor_raw_action: same physical/native roll candidate as preceding field (legacy name)

startup_experiment.decision_boundary: once at actual policy start after unchanged 1s nominal-position PD

refinement_actor_training.verification_boundary: Source/artifact/CPU-checkpoint and independent stage-ledger consistency; not a signed attestation or recovery success proof.

refinement_experiment.scope: Three-actor zero-command recovery/refinement only; original startup preparation retained, not a walk/run/full-flow demo
